in_sanskrit.name: चरणराज
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who rules over the charanam (feet) is charanaraj.

in_hindi.name: चरणराज
in_hindi.long_meaning: Charanraj is a combination of charana (feet) and raja (king). Thus, Charanraj can be translated as 'King of the feet'.

in_tamil.name: சரணராஜ்
in_tamil.long_meaning: Charanraj in Tamil is derived from the words charanam (feet) and rāj (king). Hence, Charanraj can be translated as 'King of the feet' in Tamil as well.

in_telugu.name: చరనరాజ్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Charanraj in Telugu is formed by combining the words charanam (feet) and rāj (king). Therefore, Charanraj can be interpreted as 'King of the feet' in the Telugu language.

in_marathi.name: Charanraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Footstep of God
in_marathi.long_meaning: Charanraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Charanraj is derived from two Sanskrit words – Charan (footstep) and Raj (King).
